description: Creates an official X (Twitter) web share intent link. Use when the user wants to post or tweet on X. Accepts post text, optional link URL, hashtags, and attribution handle. Validates post length against the standard 280-character limit and warns if X Premium is required. Opens the browser composer with the draft pre-filled for human review before publishing.

in_reply_to.description: Optional status ID of the tweet to reply to.

text.description: Post text (at most 25,000 characters). Standard accounts support up to 280 characters; X Premium supports up to 25,000.

url.description: Optional web link to attach to the post.

name: create_x_post

character_count.description: Estimated effective character count on X.

is_within_free_limit.description: True if within the 280-character free limit.

url_length.description: Total length of the generated intent URL.

warning.description: Warning if text exceeds free character limit or safe URL limits.

title: Create X post
